faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Chaatwala. Can't find the answer? Contact our customer support team.

questions.title: What is Chaatwala?
questions.content: Chaatwala is your one-stop destination for authentic Indian street food, bringing the flavors of chaat, biryani, and traditional snacks right to your doorstep.

questions.title: How do I place an order?
questions.content: Browse our menu, select your favorite dishes, add them to cart, and checkout. We'll deliver fresh, hot food within 30 minutes!

questions.title: What are your delivery hours?
questions.content: We deliver daily from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Order anytime during these hours for fresh, delicious food.

questions.title: Do you offer vegetarian options?
questions.content: Yes! We have a wide variety of vegetarian chaats, snacks, and main dishes. Look for the vegetarian badge on menu items.

questions.title: Can I customize my order?
questions.content: Absolutely! You can add special instructions for spice level, ingredients, and preparation during checkout.

questions.title: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.content: We accept all major credit/debit cards, mobile payment, and cash on delivery for your convenience.

questions.title: How do I track my order?
questions.content: Once your order is confirmed, you can track its status in real-time from your dashboard or the order tracking page.
